title: Not Gambling
tagline: Not Gambling is a AI agent that plays blackjack with live prediction markets on the outcomes
description: An autonomous AI plays blackjack and for each hand we run a simple prediction market where anyone can buy Yes/No shares on the outcome. Markets settle instantly when the hand ends.  Participants are predicting the AI’s moves, not playing themselves or versus a house - and NFT holders are able to stake to earn yield from the transactional volume from the prediction markets within.
how_its_made: The prediction markets and core logic are custom Solidity contracts written in house and rigorously tested (self-audited with assistance from Claude). We leverage our Uniswap hook to autocompound liquidity and make trading more efficient over time. Market resolution and payout automation are powered by Chainlink Automation. The frontend is a BaseApp mini-app, giving users one-click login and gasless experience via Coinbase Smart Wallet and the CDP stack.
